beats.name: THE FIRST RECEPTION
cap: Robbie's band plays a reception; he is
engaged to Linda and sure of his life
beats.tag: OPENING — the job and the wedding he expects

beats.name: LEFT AT THE ALTAR
cap: Linda leaves a note on the wedding day and
walks out; Robbie is left at the altar
beats.tag: BREAKUP — she leaves before the vows

beats.name: "LOVE STINKS"
cap: Shattered, Robbie hijacks another reception
with 'Love Stinks' and insults the guests
beats.tag: LOW POINT — the job becomes the wound

beats.name: THE WAITRESS
cap: Robbie meets Julia, a waitress working the
same receptions; they talk and hit it off

beats.name: HELPING JULIA PLAN
cap: Julia is engaged to Glenn; Robbie helps her
plan the wedding and they grow closer
beats.tag: FRIENDSHIP — the aisle he starts walking

beats.name: ROSIE'S ADVICE
cap: Rosie, his grandmother, tells him not to
give up on love; she is on his side
beats.tag: ADVICE — the elder voice in his corner

beats.name: THE SONG FOR JULIA
cap: Robbie writes Julia a song and sings it to
her; she is heading out to see Glenn
beats.tag: GESTURE — the first song meant only for her

beats.name: LINDA, IN LAS VEGAS
cap: In Las Vegas Julia sees Robbie with Linda
and misreads it; she pulls away from him
beats.tag: MISREAD — neither says what they mean

beats.name: THE PLANE WEDDING
cap: Glenn and Julia's wedding is set on a plane
to Las Vegas that same day; Robbie learns
beats.tag: THE CLOCK — a wedding nobody told him about

beats.name: THE RACE TO THE AIRPORT
cap: Rosie, Sammy, George and Holly get him to
the airport and onto the plane in time
beats.tag: THE RACE — the friends get him aboard

beats.name: GROW OLD WITH YOU
cap: Robbie takes the cabin microphone and sings
'Grow Old with You'; Julia walks from Glenn
beats.tag: GRAND GESTURE — the song lands this time
